reason: My Instagram is my storefront and I can't risk it getting flagged by a tool I've never heard of that sends DMs for me. And $147 a month is nearly 1% of what I make in a year, with a card-required trial that bills on day 4 and no refunds.
objection: A 3-day trial is too short to see whether anything works, then it bills and payments are final. There are no customer results, only 7 people in so far, and if it gets my account restricted I lose months of content and clients.
would_change_my_mind: A real customer with a similar-sized account showing results and saying their account was fine after months of use, plus a refund window of at least 14 days instead of final payments after day 3.
